projects.name: TxDOT DCIS All Projects
projects.notes: All TxDOT projects, past and future (66 distinct PROJ_CLASS values; 25 listed). PROJ_STG is the phase; PROJ_STAT is Active/Closed/Inactive/Paused (22,161 not Closed). Planned work = PROJ_STG in Planning/Initiate/PE/PS&E/Ready to Let/Letting etc. with PROJ_STAT='Active' (11,755 records are neither Closed nor Construction). ACTUAL_LET_DATE is filled once let. PRJ_UTP=1 flags Unified Transportation Program projects. The older TxDOT_Projects service on the same host now answers 'Token Required'.
projects.where: PROJ_STAT = 'Active' AND PROJ_STG IN ('Planning','Initiate','PE','PS&E','Ready to Let','Pre Procurement','Procurement')

parcels_statewide.name: TxGIO StratMap Land Parcels (most recent)
parcels_statewide.notes: IMPORTANT LIMIT: the layer's /query operation answers 'Requested operation is not supported by this service' (count and where-queries both fail). What does work, and was verified with real data, is the map service's identify operation: .../MapServer/identify?geometry=<lon,lat>&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&sr=4326&layers=all&tolerance=2&mapExtent=<bbox>&imageDisplay=800,800,96&returnGeometry=false&f=json returned a Travis County parcel with OWNER_NAME, MAIL_ADDR, SITUS_ADDR, MKT_VALUE (identify returns the field names in upper case). So owners can be looked up point by point along a project line, but not bulk-downloaded through this service. Other fields: geo_id, name_care, land_value, imp_value, legal_desc, fips, tax_year, source (appraisal district). Coverage and currency vary by county. Copyright text: 'TxGIO, Various Counties, Various Vendors'; no use restriction stated in the service.
parcels_statewide.held: the layer refuses area queries; only single-point lookups return owners

parcels_counties.notes: Harris County Appraisal District official layer, tax_year 2026; owner_name_2/3 for co-owners.
ArcGIS Online layer with Dallas CAD account numbers and MAPGRID '(DALLAS)'; publisher not confirmed as DCAD itself. Owner name only, no mailing address. Values are text. REVALYR 2026 in sample.
Covers all of Tarrant plus parts of Denton, Johnson, Parker and Wise counties inside Fort Worth city limits/ETJ. TAX_YEAR 2026.

Described as Bexar County Appraisal District data, updated weekly. The one sample record fetched had empty owner/address fields (a negative PropID, likely a right-of-way polygon), so field meanings are from field names plus the layer description, not from a filled sample.
Travis Central Appraisal District parcels assembled monthly by Travis County TNR. Owner name only; no mailing address or value fields.

summary: Projects: TxDOT DCIS All Projects works well (73k lines with phase, cost and let dates). Parcels: the statewide TxGIO layer has owner and mailing address but only answers point 'identify' lookups, not queries; queryable owner layers verified for Harris, Dallas, Tarrant, Bexar and Travis.
